svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: A USB port's power budget is real
These two devices, together, are a realistic way to reach it.

g.text: Typical unpowered laptop USB port budget
Same port, Astra Pro also connected
+ Astra Pro: two simultaneous USB identities
Two real devices, added together, land at or past the budget line —
not a hypothetical, a measured fact from both devices' own specs.
A device that enumerates intermittently, drops out only when a
second device joins, or a stream that stutters near a spinning LiDAR —
that's a power symptom, not a driver bug. Check power first.

svg.text: This is exactly why the BOM includes a powered USB hub — it supplies its own power, not just the host's limited budget.
